# Nimbryxo Studio Actor documentation

> Reference pages and API tutorials for the 125 public Apify Actors published by Nimbryxo Studio. Every page is generated from the Actor's published README, input schema, output definitions and Store pricing, and regenerated when the published build changes. Prices are the published pay-per-event prices; runs happen on Apify.

- Catalog: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/
- Sites A to Z: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/sites/
- Topics: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/topics/
- Guides: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/
- Machine-readable index: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors.json
- Publisher on Apify: https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio

Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/x-video-subtitle-and-caption-transcript-converter/

Returns full text, timed segments, and core video metadata. Price: $0.99 per 1,000 results on the Free plan. Export tutorial: https://hasankhokhar2026.github.io/apify-actor-examples/guides/youtube-caption-and-whisper-ai-transcript/
